card.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
card.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As venue manager, will you approve storing Tuesday's rain in this cup? The wedding needs a dry lawn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We'll catch the rain before it learns how to fall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have another wedding Wednesday. What if it leaks overnight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll seal it with Thursday's drought. Sign for two dry weddings; I'll invoice the drought after it happens.

mechanism: A seeks a venue manager's signature for temporal weather storage, making each explanation a stranger part of the plan.
confusable: Unlike merely describing magic, A must use the escalating logic to obtain formal approval for a concrete purpose.
comparison: Dry weddings lead to future drought sealing a cup; the museum scene uses an inspector's certainty as structural support.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
